text.en:
The President of the Philippines is authorized by executive order to extend the present territorial
limits of the City of Baguio by including therein adjoining municipal districts within the Mountain Province.
Any action taken by the President of the Philippines pursuant to this authority shall be submitted to the
National Assembly for its approval at the next regular session. Such action shall be valid and subsisting until
the National Assembly shall provide otherwise.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 3, 1938.
